scene_description: Wood-grain desk in a cubicle, with a white panel on the left and a gray fabric partition at the back. A blue composition notebook lies flat toward the front, with an unopened purple coffee can and an opened red coffee can standing behind it. Front is the open edge of the desk.

targets.name: blue notebook
targets.description: Blue 'College Ruled' composition notebook with a black spine on its left, lying flat in front of the two coffee cans.
targets.orientation: lying flat, front cover facing up
nearby_obstacles: Red coffee can just behind its back-right edge
targets.clearance_notes: Open desk on all sides, but it is only 1.5 cm thick, leaving little edge to grip.

candidate_improvements.description: Slide the notebook toward the front edge of the desk so part of it overhangs, exposing both covers.

targets.other_notes: Desk front edge is not visible, so no distance is given.

targets.name: purple coffee can
targets.description: Unopened purple 'Chameleon Latte classic' can standing behind the notebook, to the left of and behind the red can.
targets.clearance_notes: Several centimeters of open desk on every side.

targets.name: red coffee can
targets.description: Opened red 'Chameleon Latte double shot' can standing just behind the notebook's back-right edge, in front of and to the right of the purple can.
nearby_obstacles: Notebook edge just in front of its base
targets.clearance_notes: Sides are open above the low notebook edge, with a gap of several centimeters to the purple can.
targets.other_notes: Tab is pulled open; keep upright in case it holds liquid.

source: Staged permutation of S0021, using the same objects in a different arrangement.
